title: Verbalizing LLMs’ assumptions to explain and control sycophancy
reasoning: The paper investigates Large Language Model (LLM) sycophancy by analyzing model assumptions. It uses the AITA (Am I The Asshole) dataset, which is centered on moral judgment and social dilemmas. Furthermore, it explicitly categorizes user intents under 'moral judgment & decisions' and includes examples related to religious knowledge (e.g., questions about the Hindu deity Ganesha and Hindu mythology).
